propositions: The rebar metrics subcommand must parse --since/--until date-range flags and --output json|text flags, rendering the full metric registry over the specified range as the single entry point
A thin CLI wrapper must call rebar.metrics.registry.evaluate(spec, context) for every MetricSpec to emit each metric's value or unavailable status without CLI changes when new signals are registered
REGISTRY hydration requires importing the rebar.metrics package (not just registry) to trigger reader module registration side-effects before reading REGISTRY
The render loop must wrap each evaluate() call in exception handling to render faulting metrics as unavailable rather than crashing the whole command

JSON output (default) must include since/until and a metrics map with every registered id containing lens/source/confidence/value or unavailable with reason/accruing_since; --output text must print one line per metric in registry order

The metrics subcommand must be routed via explicit if sub == 'metrics' dispatch arm (not a frozenset) and added to the individual frozenset in test_help_overview_coverage.py, with help text and overview entries regenerating golden CLI snapshots and docs/cli-reference.md
